# Missing Configuration Error Handling

The function raises a CompileError if the configuration file is missing, which could lead to abrupt termination if a user tries to run the compiler without having initialized their repository correctly.

- `knowledge_compiler/compiler/run.py` — `knowledge_compiler.compiler.run.read_config`
